reason: The patch rewires pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:23 to call the stub NewInMemoryDB(). That stub's RunCommands always returns errors.New("not implemented") (pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16-17), and NewSQLCommand turns any TablesList error into errutil.BadRequest("sql-invalid-sql", "error reading SQL command") (pkg/expr/sql_command.go:30-35). Valid SQL that comes in through nodes.go:160 (UnmarshalSQLCommand), which has no feature-flag check, therefore fails as invalid SQL instead of with a clear 'disabled' error.
